```{r}
get_annotated_results <- function(result_object, ensembl, FDR_threshold = 0.1, log2FC_cutoff = 0.58) {
  # Retrieve gene annotations
  annot_data <- getBM(
    attributes = c('ensembl_gene_id', 'external_gene_name', 'description', "gene_biotype"),
    filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
    values = rownames(result_object),
    mart = ensembl
  )

  # Merge annotation with result object
  annot_result <- as.data.frame(result_object) %>%
    rownames_to_column("ensembl_gene_id") %>%
    left_join(annot_data, by = "ensembl_gene_id") %>%
    dplyr::rename(log2FC = log2FoldChange, FDR = padj)

  # Handle missing gene names
  annot_result <- annot_result %>% mutate(
    external_gene_name = case_when(
      external_gene_name == "" | is.na(external_gene_name) ~ ensembl_gene_id,
      TRUE ~ external_gene_name
    )
  )

  return(annotated_results = annot_result)
}


annotate_ML <- function(df, ensembl){
   # Retrieve gene annotations
  annot_data <- getBM(
    attributes = c('ensembl_gene_id', 'external_gene_name', 'description', "gene_biotype"),
    filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
    values = df$feature,
    mart = ensembl
  )

  # Merge annotation with result object
  annot_result <- as.data.frame(df) %>%
    left_join(annot_data, by = c("feature" ="ensembl_gene_id"))

  # Handle missing gene names
  annot_result <- annot_result %>% mutate(
    external_gene_name = case_when(
      external_gene_name == "" | is.na(external_gene_name) ~ feature,
      TRUE ~ external_gene_name
    )
  )

  return(annotated_results = annot_result)
}



make_volcano <- function(annotation, labs = NULL, FDR_cutoff = 0.1, log2FC_cutoff = 0.58, title, up = "red", down = "blue"){


y=4.5 #-log10(min(annotation$FDR))+0.15
xmin= -4 #min(annotation$log2FC)-0.15
xmax= 4 #max(annotation$log2FC)+0.15

keyvals_Prog <- ifelse(
    annotation$log2FC < -log2FC_cutoff & annotation$FDR<FDR_cutoff, down,
      ifelse(annotation$log2FC > log2FC_cutoff & annotation$FDR<FDR_cutoff, up,
            ifelse((annotation$log2FC< -log2FC_cutoff | annotation$log2FC> log2FC_cutoff )& annotation$FDR>FDR_cutoff,'black',
                   ifelse(annotation$log2FC > -log2FC_cutoff & annotation$log2FC < log2FC_cutoff & annotation$FDR<FDR_cutoff,'black',
        'grey'))))

 
if(is.null(labs)) {
  labels = NA
} else labels = annotation$external_gene_name

 
keyvals_Prog[is.na(keyvals_Prog)] <- 'grey'
names(keyvals_Prog)[keyvals_Prog == up] <- 'upregulated'
names(keyvals_Prog)[keyvals_Prog == 'grey'] <- 'nonsignificant'
names(keyvals_Prog)[keyvals_Prog == 'black'] <- 'mid'
names(keyvals_Prog)[keyvals_Prog == down] <- 'downregulated'

EnhancedVolcano(annotation,
                lab = labels,
                x = 'log2FC',
                y = 'FDR',
                colCustom = keyvals_Prog,
                ylab = bquote(~-Log[10] ~ "FDR"),
                selectLab = labs,
                ylim = c(0, y),
                xlim = c(xmin,xmax),
                title = title,
                subtitle = NULL,
                legendPosition = "top",
                boxedLabels = TRUE,
                drawConnectors = TRUE,
                legendLabSize = 9,
                legendIconSize = 3,
                max.overlaps = 12,
                axisLabSize = 16,
                titleLabSize = 13,
                colAlpha = 0.7,
                pCutoff = FDR_cutoff,
                FCcutoff = 0.5,
                pointSize = 3.7,
                labSize = 6.5,
                gridlines.minor = FALSE,
    gridlines.major = FALSE)


}

BP_MF_GSEA <- function(annotation, comp = "ABvAA"){
  
genelist=annotation$log2FC
names(genelist) = as.character(annotation$ensembl_gene_id)
genelist = sort(genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
set.seed(12345)

GSEA_BP <- gseGO(geneList     = genelist,
              OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
              ont          = "BP",
              keyType       = 'ENSEMBL',
              minGSSize    = 10,
              maxGSSize    = 500,
              pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
              verbose      = TRUE)


GSEA_BP_Annot <- setReadable(GSEA_BP, 'org.Hs.eg.db', 'ENSEMBL')

set.seed(12345)

GSEA_MF <- gseGO(geneList     = genelist,
              OrgDb        = org.Hs.eg.db,
              ont          = "MF",
              keyType       = 'ENSEMBL',
              minGSSize    = 10,
              maxGSSize    = 500,
              pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
              verbose      = TRUE)


GSEA_MF_Annot <- setReadable(GSEA_MF, 'org.Hs.eg.db', 'ENSEMBL')

GSEA_list <- list(
  GSEA_BP_Annot,
  GSEA_MF_Annot
)

names(GSEA_list) <- c(
  paste0("BP_", comp),
  paste0("MF_", comp)
)
  return(GSEA_list) 
  
}


simplify_gsea <- function(gsea_list, sim_cutoff = 0.7){
  set.seed(12345)

  gsea_list_simple <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_along(gsea_list)){
  gsea <- gsea_list[[i]]
  name <- names(gsea_list)[[i]]
  
  gsea_new <- clusterProfiler::simplify(x = gsea, cutoff = sim_cutoff)
  
  gsea_list_simple[[name]] <- pairwise_termsim(gsea_new)
  
}
  
  return(gsea_list_simple)
  
}


gsea_simple_df <- function(gsea_simple_list, topcat=5000, jacc_ord = FALSE){
  set.seed(12345)

  simple_df <- list()
  
  
      
    for (i in seq_along(gsea_simple_list)){
      x <- gsea_simple_list[[i]]
      name <- names(gsea_simple_list)[[i]]
      fortify_df <- fortify(x,showCategory=topcat)
        
      
    if (jacc_ord && !is.null(x@termsim) && nrow(x@termsim) >= 2) {
      # Compute Jaccard similarity ordering
      jaccard_similarity_matrix <- x@termsim
      # Convert the Jaccard similarity matrix to a distance matrix
      jaccard_distance_matrix <- 1 - jaccard_similarity_matrix
      
      hclust_result <- hclust(dist(jaccard_distance_matrix))
      order_of_terms <- hclust_result$order
      labels <- hclust_result$labels[order_of_terms]
      fortify_df$Description <- factor(fortify_df$Description, levels = labels)
    } else {
      # Keep the original order
      fortify_df$Description <- factor(fortify_df$Description, levels = fortify_df$Description)
    }

    write.csv(fortify_df,file=paste0("~/GO/",name,"_F.csv"))
    
     simple_df[[name]]<-fortify_df
    }
  
  
  
  return(simple_df)
}
```

```{r}
run_glmnet_nestedcv<- function(X, y, alpha = 1,outer_folds = 5, inner_folds = 3) {
  set.seed(12345)
  # Create outer folds
  outer_cv <- createFolds(Y, k = outer_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  outer_auc <- numeric(length(outer_cv))
  all_preds <- list()
  feature_list <- list()
  importance_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(importance_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  
  
  for (i in seq_along(outer_cv)) {
  cat("Outer fold", i, "of", outer_folds, "\n")
  
  train_idx <- outer_cv[[i]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_along(Y), train_idx)
  
  X_train <- as.matrix(X[train_idx, ])
  Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
  X_test  <- as.matrix(X[test_idx, ])
  Y_test  <- Y[test_idx]
  
    # 3-fold CV with 5 repeats
    ctrl <- trainControl(
      method = "repeatedcv",
      number = inner_folds,
      repeats = 5,
      classProbs = TRUE,
      summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
    )
    
    set.seed(i)
    # Train model
    model <- train(
      x = X_train,
      y = as.factor(Y_train),
      method = "glmnet",
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = alpha, lambda = 10^seq(-3, 0, length = 20)),
      metric = "ROC"
    )
    
    # --- Predict on outer test fold ---
    pred_prob <- predict(model, X_test, type = "prob")[, 2]
    roc_obj <- roc(Y_test, pred_prob)
    auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
    outer_auc[i] <- auc_val
    
    # --- Store individual ROC data for later plotting ---
    roc_df <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      one_minus_spec = 1 - roc_obj$specificities
    )
    all_preds[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      true_label = Y_test,
      pred_prob = pred_prob
    )
  
    # --- Extract coefficients (non-zero only) ---
    best_lambda <- model$bestTune$lambda
    final_fit <- glmnet(X_train, Y_train, alpha = alpha, family = "binomial", lambda = best_lambda)
    coefs <- as.matrix(coef(final_fit))
    nonzero <- rownames(coefs)[coefs != 0]
    nonzero <- nonzero[nonzero != "(Intercept)"]
    
    # --- Save feature list ---
    feature_list[[i]] <- data.frame(feature = nonzero, coef = as.numeric(coefs[nonzero, ]))
    
    # --- Store importance ---
    imp <- varImp(model)$importance
    matched_imp <- imp[match(colnames(X), rownames(imp)), 1]
    importance_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_imp), 0, matched_imp)
  }
  
  # --- Feature stability ---
  feature_stability <- bind_rows(feature_list) %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarise(
      selection_freq = n() / length(outer_cv),
      mean_coef = mean(coef)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_freq))
  
  # --- Combine importance ---
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    feature = colnames(X),
    mean_importance = colMeans(importance_matrix),
    importance_sd = apply(importance_matrix, 2, sd)
  )
  
  feature_stability <- merge(feature_stability, importance_df, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # --- Combine all predictions ---
  all_preds_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)
  
  # --- Return results ---
  list(
    auc = mean(outer_auc),
    auc_sd = sd(outer_auc),
    outer_auc = outer_auc,
    feature_stability = feature_stability,
    all_preds = all_preds_df
  )
}




run_rf_boruta_nestedcv<- function(X, Y, outer_folds = 5, inner_folds = 3) {
  
  set.seed(12345)
  # Create outer folds
  outer_cv <- createFolds(Y, k = outer_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  
  outer_auc <- numeric(length(outer_cv))
  all_preds <- list()
  feature_list <- list()

  importance_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  mda_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  gini_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(importance_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  colnames(mda_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  colnames(gini_matrix) <- colnames(X)

  
  for (i in seq_along(outer_cv)) {
  cat("Outer fold", i, "of", outer_folds, "\n")
  
  train_idx <- outer_cv[[i]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_along(Y), train_idx)
  
  X_train <- as.matrix(X[train_idx, ])
  Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
  X_test  <- as.matrix(X[test_idx, ])
  Y_test  <- Y[test_idx]
  
    # 3-fold CV with 5 repeats with Boruta feature selection (ONLY on training data)
    set.seed(i) # For reproducibility
    boruta <- Boruta(X_train, as.factor(Y_train), maxRuns = 50) 
    selected_features <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta, withTentative = TRUE)
    
    X_train_boruta <- X_train[, selected_features, drop = FALSE]
    X_test_boruta  <- X_test[, selected_features, drop = FALSE]
    
    # 3. Train RF on Boruta-selected features
    ctrl <- trainControl(
      method = "none",  # no resampling; rely on OOB
       classProbs = TRUE,
      summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
      )
    
    p <- length(selected_features)


    model <- train(
      x = X_train_boruta,
      y = make.names(Y_train), # caret requires valid factor names
      method = "rf",
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(X)))),
      metric = "ROC",
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    
    # --- Predict on outer test fold ---
    pred_prob <- predict(model, X_test_boruta, type = "prob")[, 2]
    roc_obj <- roc(Y_test, pred_prob)
    auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
    outer_auc[i] <- auc_val
    
    # --- Store individual ROC data for later plotting ---
    roc_df <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      one_minus_spec = 1 - roc_obj$specificities
    )
    
    # --- Save predictions ---
    all_preds[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      true_label = Y_test,
      pred_prob = pred_prob
    )
  

    # --- Save feature list ---
    feature_list[[i]] <- data.frame(feature = selected_features)
    

    # SAFELY store variable importance
    imp <- varImp(model)$importance
    
    mda  <- importance(model$finalModel)[,"MeanDecreaseAccuracy"]
    gini <- importance(model$finalModel)[,"MeanDecreaseGini"]
    
    matched_imp <- imp[match(colnames(X), rownames(imp)), 1]
    matched_mda <-  mda[match(colnames(X), names(mda))]
    matched_gini <- gini[match(colnames(X), names(gini))]
    
    importance_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_imp), 0, matched_imp)
    mda_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_mda), 0, matched_mda)
    gini_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_gini), 0, matched_gini)
    
  }

  
  # --- Feature stability ---
  feature_stability <- bind_rows(feature_list) %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarise(selection_freq = n() / length(outer_cv)) %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_freq))
  
  # --- Combine importance ---
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    feature = colnames(X),
    mean_importance = colMeans(importance_matrix),
    importance_sd = apply(importance_matrix, 2, sd),
    Mean_MDA = colMeans(mda_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_MDA = apply(mda_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Gini = colMeans(gini_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Gini = apply(gini_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  feature_stability <- merge(feature_stability, importance_df, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # --- Combine all predictions ---
  all_preds_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)
  
  # --- Return results ---
  list(
    auc = mean(outer_auc),
    auc_sd = sd(outer_auc),
    outer_auc = outer_auc,
    feature_stability = feature_stability,
    all_preds = all_preds_df
  )
}



plot_rocs <- function(lasso_res) {
  roc_data <- lasso_res$all_preds

  # Initialize ggplot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add reference line
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

  # Plot individual outer fold ROC curves
  for (i in unique(roc_data$fold)) {
    fold_data <- roc_data[roc_data$fold == i, ]
    fold_roc <- roc(fold_data$true_label, fold_data$pred_prob)

    fold_df <- data.frame(
      x = 1 - rev(fold_roc$specificities),  # ascending 1 - specificity
      y = rev(fold_roc$sensitivities)       # ascending sensitivity
    )

    p <- p + geom_step(
      data = fold_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "pink",
      alpha = 0.8,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  }

  # Plot overall ROC (all outer folds combined)
  overall_roc <- roc(roc_data$true_label, roc_data$pred_prob)
  overall_df <- data.frame(
    x = 1 - rev(overall_roc$specificities),
    y = rev(overall_roc$sensitivities)
  )

  set.seed(12345)
  ci_auc <- ci.auc(overall_roc, method = "bootstrap")

  p <- p + geom_step(
    data = overall_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
    labs(
      title = "Nested CV ROC Curve",
      subtitle = sprintf("AUC = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f–%.3f)",
                         auc(overall_roc), ci_auc[1], ci_auc[3]),
      x = "1 - Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_minimal()

  return(p)
}
```

load necessary files and convert columns to factors or numbers etc as needed (usually need as factors). If you have continous variables, suggested to break up into meaningful bins, unless each continous change is specifically meaningful. Age for example I brokeup into 4 groups of roughly 10 years.

### PCA


```{r }
CardioProg_A_B <- droplevels(CardioProg_A_B)

ddsProg_A_B=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = Counts_Prog_A_B, 
        colData =CardioProg_A_B, design= ~  Media + SeqBatch +  Group2 + Sex + Group2:Sex)
keepddsProg_A_B= rowSums(counts(ddsProg_A_B)>= 10) >=9 #keeps genes with at least 9 samples with 10 counts
ddsProg_A_B <- ddsProg_A_B[keepddsProg_A_B,]
```

For PCA plots you need to normalize. Can be done with rld or vst. You can plot to see which is best. Want to see a fairly even line along x=y. rlog seems to work a bit better but is VERY slow with many samples so I did vst.

These techniques use compute a variance stabilizing transformation which is roughly similar to putting the data on the log2 scale, while also dealing with the sampling variability of low counts. It uses the design formula to calculate the within-group variability (if blind=FALSE), but it does not use the design to remove variation in the data

```{r , message=FALSE}
vstProg_A_B <- vst(ddsProg_A_B, blind = FALSE)
```

```{r,message=FALSE}

rv_Prog_A_B <- rowVars(assay(vstProg_A_B))
pcagenes_Prog_A_B <-  order(rv_Prog_A_B, decreasing=TRUE)[seq_len(min(500, length(rv_Prog_A_B)))]
pca_Prog_A_B <- prcomp(t(assay(vstProg_A_B)[pcagenes_Prog_A_B,]))
percentVar_Prog_A_B <- pca_Prog_A_B$sdev^2 / sum( pca_Prog_A_B$sdev^2 )


autoplot(pca_Prog_A_B, x=1, y=2, data=CardioProg_A_B, colour="Sex") + theme_classic()
ggsave(filename="~/Images/PCA/PCA1_2_Sex_Prog_A_B.pdf", height=3, width=4)

autoplot(pca_Prog_A_B, x=1, y=2, data=CardioProg_A_B, colour="Media")+ theme_classic() + scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","steelblue3"))
ggsave(filename="~/Images/PCA/PCA1_2_Media_Prog_A_B.pdf", height=3, width=4.1)

autoplot(pca_Prog_A_B, x=3, y=4, data=CardioProg_A_B, colour="SeqBatch")+ theme_classic() + scale_color_manual(values = c("orange","turquoise4","violetred4"))
ggsave(filename="~/Images/PCA/PCA3_4_SeqBatch_Prog_A_B.pdf", height=3, width=4.5)


```

### Cross-validation

first remove bathc effects using combat-seq

In ComBat-seq, user may specify biological covariates, whose signals will be preserved in the adjusted data. If the user would like to specify one biological variable, they may use the group parameter:

 
```{r}

adj_Counts_Prog_A_B <- ComBat_seq(as.matrix(Counts_Prog_A_B), batch=CardioProg_A_B$SeqBatch, group=CardioProg_A_B$Group2)


dds_forest_A_B <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = adj_Counts_Prog_A_B,  # Batch-corrected counts
  colData = CardioProg_A_B,
  design = ~ 1            # Primary variable of interest (progressors vs. non-progressors)
)

keepdds_forest_A_B= rowSums(counts(dds_forest_A_B)>= 10) >=9
dds_forest_A_B <- dds_forest_A_B[keepdds_forest_A_B,]
dds_forest_A_B <- DESeq(dds_forest_A_B)
vst_forest_A_B <- vst(dds_forest_A_B, blind = FALSE)



vst_forest_A_B_matrix<-assay(vst_forest_A_B)
gene_vars_A_B <- apply(vst_forest_A_B_matrix, 1, var)
vst_forest_A_B_top <- vst_forest_A_B_matrix[gene_vars_A_B > quantile(gene_vars_A_B, 0.4), ]
```


lasso nested repeated cross-validation for training and validaiton

```{r}

library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

set.seed(12345)
# Create k outer folds
X <- as.matrix(t(vst_forest_A_B_top))  # Ensure it's a matrix (genes as columns, samples as rows)
Y <- factor(CardioProg_A_B$Group2)  # Ensure it's a factor (0 = non-progressor, 1 = progressor)

```


```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4.0}

lasso_nested_A_B <- run_glmnet_nestedcv(X, Y, alpha = 1, outer_folds = 4, inner_folds = 3)



lasso_features_A_B_sig<-lasso_nested_A_B$feature_stability
lasso_features_A_B_sig<- subset(lasso_features_A_B_sig, selection_freq > 0)


lasso_features_A_B_sig = annotate_ML(lasso_features_A_B_sig,ensembl)


lasso_features_A_B_sig <- lasso_features_A_B_sig[
  order(lasso_features_A_B_sig$mean_importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(lasso_features_A_B_sig,file="~/ML/lasso_features_A_B_sig_all.csv")

ggplot(lasso_features_A_B_sig[1:30,], aes(x = reorder(external_gene_name, mean_importance), y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = selection_freq)) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_importance - importance_sd, ymax = mean_importance + importance_sd),width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", name = "selection_freq") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Importance",
    title = "Top 30 Lasso"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()




# Outer loop performance
cat("Mean outer AUC:", round(mean(lasso_nested_A_B$outer_auc), 3),
    "±", round(sd(lasso_nested_A_B$outer_auc), 3), "\n")





ggsave(filename="~/ML/top30_lasso_AvB_all.pdf",width = 4.5, height=4) 

# ROC plot (using your existing function)
plot_rocs(lasso_nested_A_B)

ggsave(filename="~/ML/roc_lasso_AvB_all.pdf",width = 4, height=4.2) 
```

```{r}
phenocols_F = list(Group2 = c(AA="#f5b5d6",
```

## DGE for Chagas progressors (A -> B1/B2/C) vs non-progressors (A -> A) at time before progression occurs

Subset patients (for both your condition and count file) to only include timepoint 1 to look for biomarkers of progression (rather than changes that have already occured at timepoint2).  
```{r , echo=FALSE}
set.seed(12345)
CardioProg_A_B_F=subset(Cardioinfo_F,Time=="1" & Infected=="Pos" & (Group2=="AA"|Group2=="AB1.B2"))
CardioProg_A_B_F=droplevels(CardioProg_A_B_F)
Counts_Prog_A_B_F=subset(Cardiocountsonly_F, select=CardioProg_A_B_F$Code)
CardioProg_A_B_F$cardiac_freq = as.numeric(CardioProg_A_B_F$cardiac_freq)


table(CardioProg_A_B_F$Group2)
```



```{r }
ddsProg_A_B_F=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = Counts_Prog_A_B_F, 
        colData =CardioProg_A_B_F, design= ~  Media + SeqBatch + Group2) #  
keepddsProg_A_B_F= rowSums(counts(ddsProg_A_B_F)>= 10) >=9 #keeps genes with at least 6 samples with 10 counts
ddsProg_A_B_F <- ddsProg_A_B_F[keepddsProg_A_B_F,]
```



```{r , message=FALSE}
vstProg_A_B_F <- vst(ddsProg_A_B_F, blind = FALSE)
```





### DEGs

Fit the model.
```{r }
#, results='hide', message=FALSE
ddsProg_A_B_F=DESeq(ddsProg_A_B_F) #normalizes, estimates dispersion and fits glm
```


alpha sets FDR (default is 0.1), can also set lfcthreshold  
```{r }
resultProg_A_B_F=results(ddsProg_A_B_F,alpha = 0.05,contrast=c("Group2", "AB1.B2", "AA")) 
summary(resultProg_A_B_F)

```


Since contrast was AB vs AA, the Up regulated genes are upregulated in AB compared to AA, and same from down regulated.  

&nbsp;  


```{r}
annotProg_A_B_F <- get_annotated_results(resultProg_A_B_F, ensembl)
SigAnnotProg_A_B_F <- subset(annotProg_A_B_F, FDR < 0.05 & (log2FC > 0.58 | log2FC< -0.58 ))

write.csv(SigAnnotProg_A_B_F,"~/DEG/SigAnnotProg_A_B_F_F.csv")
```


Volcano plot of data, adjust xlim and ylim to fit all your data points. The positive fold change indicates up regulated genes in AB compared to AA, and the negative fold change are those down regulated in AB compared to AA.  
```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}

make_volcano(annotProg_A_B_F, labs = c("SPP1","LMOD1"), 
             FDR_cutoff = 0.05, log2FC_cutoff = 0.58, title = "A->A v A->B", up = "#e3599e", down = "#f5b5d6")

ggsave(filename="~/Images/ABvAA_F_Volcano_select_labeled.pdf",height=6.5, width = 7)
```



### GSEA
&nbsp;
All genes can be used in GSEA; GSEA aggregates the per gene statistics across genes within a gene set, therefore making it possible to detect situations where all genes in a predefined set change in a small but coordinated way. This is important since it is likely that many relevant phenotypic differences are manifested by small but consistent changes in a set of genes. the goal of GSEA is to determine whether the members of S are randomly distributed throughout the ranked gene list (L) or primarily found at the top or bottom. When the entire gene sets are evaluated, the estimated significance level is adjusted to account for multiple hypothesis testing and also q-values are calculated for FDR control.




```{r}
gsea_list_Prog_A_B_F= BP_MF_GSEA(annotation = annotProg_A_B_F, comp = "ABvAA") 


simple_gsea_list_Prog_A_B_F=simplify_gsea(gsea_list_Prog_A_B_F, sim_cutoff = 0.7)
simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_F = gsea_simple_df(simple_gsea_list_Prog_A_B_F)



max_nes <- 3.201644+0.001#3.007278+0.001
min_nes <- -3.201644-0.001
max_pval <- 8.011847+0.001
min_pval <- 2.590568-0.001

ht = 2.02
  
wrap_width <- 50
  
  
  
  
  
```

```{r, fig.width=3.4928, fig.height=2}
for (i in seq_along(simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_F[1])) {
  
  x <- simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_F[[i]]
  name <- names(simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_F)[[i]]
  
  if (nrow(x)>10){
    x <- x[1:10,]
  }

  
wrapped_labels <- strwrap(as.character(x$Description), width = wrap_width)
  
  # get max line length AFTER wrapping
  max_line_length <- max(nchar(unlist(wrapped_labels)), na.rm = TRUE)
    
  wd <- 2.3 + 0.0284 * max_line_length  
  print(paste0("length: ",max_line_length))
  print(paste0("width: ",wd))
  
# predefine limits and breaks
  
p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = GeneRatio, y = Description, size = -log10(p.adjust), color = NES)) +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE, aes(size = -log10(p.adjust), color = NES), shape = 21, fill = NA, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +  
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE, aes(size = -log10(p.adjust), fill = NES), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.6)+  # Avoid plotting NA values
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.2, 2.2), limits = c(min_pval, max_pval)) + # Avoid size for missing data
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(50), limits = rev, position = "right") +
  
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#f5b5d6", mid = "lightgrey",high = "#e3599e",midpoint = 0, limits = c(-max_nes, max_nes)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#f5b5d6", mid = "lightgrey",high = "#e3599e",midpoint = 0, limits = c(-max_nes, max_nes)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1)))+
    theme_minimal() +
  #scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.3, 1)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black",hjust = 0),
      title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(7, "pt"),
      legend.position = "left")+
   ggtitle(name)+
   ylab(NULL)+ xlab(NULL)

print(p)

  ggsave(p,filename=paste0("~/Images/GO/top10_gsea",name,"_F.pdf"),width = wd, height=ht) 
}
```

### Cross-validation
first remove batch effects using combat-seq

In ComBat-seq, user may specify biological covariates, whose signals will be preserved in the adjusted data. If the user would like to specify one biological variable, they may use the group parameter:
 
```{r}

adj_Counts_Prog_A_B_F <- ComBat_seq(as.matrix(Counts_Prog_A_B_F), batch=CardioProg_A_B_F$SeqBatch, group=CardioProg_A_B_F$Group2)


dds_forest_A_B_F <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = adj_Counts_Prog_A_B_F,  # Batch-corrected counts
  colData = CardioProg_A_B_F,
  design = ~ 1            # Primary variable of interest (progressors vs. non-progressors)
)

keepdds_forest_A_B_F= rowSums(counts(dds_forest_A_B_F)>= 10) >=9
dds_forest_A_B_F <- dds_forest_A_B_F[keepdds_forest_A_B_F,]
dds_forest_A_B_F <- DESeq(dds_forest_A_B_F)
vst_forest_A_B_F <- vst(dds_forest_A_B_F, blind = FALSE)


vst_forest_A_B_F_sig <- vst_forest_A_B_F[SigAnnotProg_A_B_F$ensembl_gene_id,]
vst_forest_A_B_F_sig<-assay(vst_forest_A_B_F_sig)
vst_forest_A_B_F_matrix<-assay(vst_forest_A_B_F)
gene_vars_A_B_F <- apply(vst_forest_A_B_F_matrix, 1, var)
vst_forest_A_B_F_top <- vst_forest_A_B_F_matrix[gene_vars_A_B_F > quantile(gene_vars_A_B_F, 0.4), ]
```


lasso nested repeated cross-validation for training and validaiton

```{r}



set.seed(12345)
# Create k outer folds
X <- as.matrix(t(vst_forest_A_B_F_top))  # Ensure it's a matrix (genes as columns, samples as rows)
Y <- factor(CardioProg_A_B_F$Group2)  # Ensure it's a factor (0 = non-progressor, 1 = progressor)

```


```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4.0}

lasso_nested_A_B_F <- run_glmnet_nestedcv(X, Y, alpha = 1, outer_folds = 4, inner_folds = 3)



lasso_features_A_B_F_sig<-lasso_nested_A_B_F$feature_stability
lasso_features_A_B_F_sig<- subset(lasso_features_A_B_F_sig, selection_freq > 0)


lasso_features_A_B_F_sig = annotate_ML(lasso_features_A_B_F_sig,ensembl)


lasso_features_A_B_F_sig <- lasso_features_A_B_F_sig[
  order(lasso_features_A_B_F_sig$mean_importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(lasso_features_A_B_F_sig,file="~/ML/lasso_features_A_B_F_sig_F.csv")

ggplot(lasso_features_A_B_F_sig[1:30,], aes(x = reorder(external_gene_name, mean_importance), y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = selection_freq)) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_importance - importance_sd, ymax = mean_importance + importance_sd),width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", name = "selection_freq") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Importance",
    title = "Top 30 Lasso"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()




# Outer loop performance
cat("Mean outer AUC:", round(mean(lasso_nested_A_B_F$outer_auc), 3),
    "±", round(sd(lasso_nested_A_B_F$outer_auc), 3), "\n")





ggsave(filename="~/Images/ML/top30_lasso_AvB_F.pdf",width = 4.5, height=4) 

# ROC plot (using your existing function)
plot_rocs(lasso_nested_A_B_F)

ggsave(filename="~/Images/ML/roc_lasso_AvB_F.pdf",width = 4, height=4.2)
```

```{r , echo=FALSE}
table(CardioProg_B_CD_F$Group2)
```


### Cross-validation

first remove bathc effects using combat-seq

In ComBat-seq, user may specify biological covariates, whose signals will be preserved in the adjusted data. If the user would like to specify one biological variable, they may use the group parameter:
 
```{r}

adj_Counts_Prog_B_CD_F <- ComBat_seq(as.matrix(Counts_Prog_B_CD_F), batch=CardioProg_B_CD_F$SeqBatch, group=CardioProg_B_CD_F$Group2)



dds_forest_B_CD_F <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = adj_Counts_Prog_B_CD_F,  # Batch-corrected counts
  colData = CardioProg_B_CD_F,
  design = ~ 1             # Primary variable of interest (progressors vs. non-progressors)
)

keepdds_forest_B_CD_F= rowSums(counts(dds_forest_B_CD_F)>= 10) >=9
dds_forest_B_CD_F <- dds_forest_B_CD_F[keepdds_forest_B_CD_F,]
dds_forest_B_CD_F <- DESeq(dds_forest_B_CD_F)

vst_forest_B_CD_F <- vst(dds_forest_B_CD_F, blind = FALSE)
vst_forest_B_CD_F_matrix<-assay(vst_forest_B_CD_F)
gene_vars <- apply(vst_forest_B_CD_F_matrix, 1, var)
vst_forest_B_CD_F_top <- vst_forest_B_CD_F_matrix[gene_vars > quantile(gene_vars, 0.4), ]

```


lasso nested repeated cross-validation for training and validaiton

```{r}


set.seed(12345)
# Create k outer folds
X <- as.matrix(t(vst_forest_B_CD_F_top))  # Ensure it's a matrix (genes as columns, samples as rows)
Y <- factor(CardioProg_B_CD_F$Group2)  # Ensure it's a factor (0 = non-progressor, 1 = progressor)

```


```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4.0}
lasso_nested_B_CD_F <- run_glmnet_nestedcv(X, Y, alpha = 1, outer_folds = 4, inner_folds = 3)



lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig<-lasso_nested_B_CD_F$feature_stability
lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig<- subset(lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig, selection_freq > 0)

lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig = annotate_ML(lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig,ensembl)



lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig <- lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig[
  order(lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig$mean_importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig,file="~/ML/lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig_F.csv")

ggplot(lasso_features_B_CD_F_sig[1:30,], aes(x = reorder(external_gene_name, mean_importance), y = mean_importance)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = selection_freq)) +
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_importance - importance_sd, ymax = mean_importance + importance_sd),width = 0.2, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", name = "selection_freq") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Importance",
    title = "Top 30 Lasso"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()




# Outer loop performance
cat("Mean outer AUC:", round(mean(lasso_nested_B_CD_F$outer_auc), 3),
    "±", round(sd(lasso_nested_B_CD_F$outer_auc), 3), "\n")





ggsave(filename="~/Images/ML/top30_lasso_B_CD_F_F.pdf",width = 4.5, height=4) 

# ROC plot (using your existing function)
plot_rocs(lasso_nested_B_CD_F)

ggsave(filename="~/Images/ML/roc_lasso_B_CD_F_F.pdf",width = 4, height=4.2)
```

## DGE for Chagas progressors (A -> B1/B2) vs non-progressors (A -> A) at time before progression occurs

Subset patients (for both your condition and count file) to only include timepoint 1 to look for biomarkers of progression (rather than changes that have already occured at timepoint2).  
```{r , echo=FALSE}
CardioProg_A_B_M=subset(Cardioinfo_M,Time=="1" & Infected=="Pos" & (Group2=="AA"|Group2=="AB1.B2"))
CardioProg_A_B_M=droplevels(CardioProg_A_B_M)
Counts_Prog_A_B_M=subset(Cardiocountsonly_M, select=CardioProg_A_B_M$Code)
CardioProg_A_B_M$cardiac_freq = as.numeric(CardioProg_A_B_M$cardiac_freq)


table(CardioProg_A_B_M$Group2)
```


```{r }
ddsProg_A_B_M=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = Counts_Prog_A_B_M, 
        colData =CardioProg_A_B_M, design= ~  Media + SeqBatch + Group2)
keepddsProg_A_B_M= rowSums(counts(ddsProg_A_B_M)>= 10) >=9 #keeps genes with at least 10 samples with 10 counts (edit to 10 when get additional samples)
ddsProg_A_B_M <- ddsProg_A_B_M[keepddsProg_A_B_M,]
```


```{r , message=FALSE}
vstProg_A_B_M <- vst(ddsProg_A_B_M, blind = FALSE)
```



### DEG
Fit the model.
```{r}
#, results='hide', message=FALSE
ddsProg_A_B_M=DESeq(ddsProg_A_B_M) #normalizes, estimates dispersion and fits glm
```


alpha sets FDR (default is 0.1), can also set lfcthreshold  
```{r }
resultProg_A_B_M=results(ddsProg_A_B_M,alpha = 0.05,contrast=c("Group2", "AB1.B2", "AA")) 
summary(resultProg_A_B_M)
```

Since contrast was AB vs AA, the Up regulated genes are upregulated in AB compared to AA, and same from down regulated.  

&nbsp;  

Annotate the ensemble ID with their gene name using biomart (I find this is more complete than org.Hs.eg.db, but it requires internet connection and is a bit slower).  


```{r}

annotProg_A_B_M <- get_annotated_results(resultProg_A_B_M, ensembl)
SigAnnotProg_A_B_M <- subset(annotProg_A_B_M, FDR < 0.05& (log2FC > 0.58 | log2FC< -0.58 ))

write.csv(SigAnnotProg_A_B_M,"~/DEG/SigAnnotProg_A_B_M_M.csv")
```

Volcano plot of data, adjust xlim and ylim to fit all your data points.  The positive fold change indicates up regulated genes in AB compared to AA, and the negative fold change are those down regulated in AB compared to AA.  
```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=7}

make_volcano(annotProg_A_B_M, labs = c("APOL4","EGOT","ZEB2-AS1","CD44-AS1","HHAT","IGLV2-8","IGLV3-19","IGLV3-10","IGHV3-49"),
FDR_cutoff = 0.05, log2FC_cutoff = 0.58, title = "A->A v A->B", up = "#f0c405", down = "#f8fa89" )

ggsave(filename="~/Images/ABvAA_M_Volcano_labeled.pdf",height=6.5, width = 7)
```



### GSEA

&nbsp;
All genes can be used in GSEA; GSEA aggregates the per gene statistics across genes within a gene set, therefore making it possible to detect situations where all genes in a predefined set change in a small but coordinated way. This is important since it is likely that many relevant phenotypic differences are manifested by small but consistent changes in a set of genes. the goal of GSEA is to determine whether the members of S are randomly distributed throughout the ranked gene list (L) or primarily found at the top or bottom. When the entire gene sets are evaluated, the estimated significance level is adjusted to account for multiple hypothesis testing and also q-values are calculated for FDR control.




```{r}
gsea_list_Prog_A_B_M= BP_MF_GSEA(annotation = annotProg_A_B_M, comp = "ABvAA") 





simple_gsea_list_Prog_A_B_M=simplify_gsea(gsea_list_Prog_A_B_M, sim_cutoff = 0.7)
simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_M = gsea_simple_df(simple_gsea_list_Prog_A_B_M)

```

```{r, fig.width=3.5496, fig.height=2}
for (i in seq_along(simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_M)) {
  
  x <- simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_M[[i]]
  name <- names(simple_gsea_df_Prog_A_B_M)[[i]]
  
  if (nrow(x)>10){
    x <- x[1:10,]
  }
  
  
wrapped_labels <- strwrap(as.character(x$Description), width = wrap_width)
  
  # get max line length AFTER wrapping
  max_line_length <- max(nchar(unlist(wrapped_labels)), na.rm = TRUE)
    
  wd <- 2.3 + 0.0284 * max_line_length  
  print(paste0("length: ",max_line_length))
  print(paste0("width: ",wd))
   
p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = GeneRatio, y = Description, size = -log10(p.adjust), color = NES)) +
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE, aes(size = -log10(p.adjust), color = NES), shape = 21, fill = NA, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +  
    geom_point(na.rm = TRUE, aes(size = -log10(p.adjust), fill = NES), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.6)+  # Avoid plotting NA values
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.2, 2.2), limits = c(min_pval, max_pval)) + # Avoid size for missing data
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(50), limits = rev, position = "right") +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#f8fa89", mid = "lightgrey",high = "#f0c405",midpoint = 0 ,limits = c(min_nes, max_nes)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#f8fa89", mid = "lightgrey",high = "#f0c405",midpoint = 0 ,limits = c(min_nes, max_nes)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.1)))+
    theme_minimal() +
  #scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.3, 1)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6.5, color = "black"),
      panel.grid = element_line(linewidth = 0.2),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black",hjust = 0),
      title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 5.5),
      legend.key.size = unit(7, "pt"),
      legend.position = "left")+
   ggtitle(name)+
   ylab(NULL)+ xlab(NULL)

print(p)

  ggsave(p,filename=paste0("~/Images/GO/top10_gsea",name,"_M.pdf"),width = wd, height=ht) 
}
```

### GSEA GO

&nbsp;
All genes can be used in GSEA; GSEA aggregates the per gene statistics across genes within a gene set, therefore making it possible to detect situations where all genes in a predefined set change in a small but coordinated way. This is important since it is likely that many relevant phenotypic differences are manifested by small but consistent changes in a set of genes. the goal of GSEA is to determine whether the members of S are randomly distributed throughout the ranked gene list (L) or primarily found at the top or bottom. When the entire gene sets are evaluated, the estimated significance level is adjusted to account for multiple hypothesis testing and also q-values are calculated for FDR control.




lasso nested repeated cross-validation for training and validaiton

```{r}

library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(pROC)

set.seed(12345)
# Create k outer folds
X <- as.matrix(t(vst_forest_B_CD_M_top))  # Ensure it's a matrix (genes as columns, samples as rows)
Y <- factor(CardioProg_B_CD_M$Group2)  # Ensure it's a factor (0 = non-progressor, 1 = progressor)

```

```{r}
run_glmnet_nestedcv<- function(X, y, alpha = 1,outer_folds = 5, inner_folds = 3) {
  # Create outer folds
  outer_cv <- createFolds(Y, k = outer_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  outer_auc <- numeric(length(outer_cv))
  all_preds <- list()
  feature_list <- list()
  importance_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(importance_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  
  
  for (i in seq_along(outer_cv)) {
  cat("Outer fold", i, "of", outer_folds, "\n")
  
  train_idx <- outer_cv[[i]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_along(Y), train_idx)
  
  X_train <- as.matrix(X[train_idx, ])
  Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
  X_test  <- as.matrix(X[test_idx, ])
  Y_test  <- Y[test_idx]
  
    # 3-fold CV with 5 repeats
    ctrl <- trainControl(
      method = "repeatedcv",
      number = inner_folds,
      repeats = 5,
      classProbs = TRUE,
      summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
    )
    
    set.seed(i)
    # Train model
    model <- train(
      x = X_train,
      y = as.factor(Y_train),
      method = "glmnet",
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = expand.grid(alpha = alpha, lambda = 10^seq(-3, 0, length = 20)),
      metric = "ROC"
    )
    
    # --- Predict on outer test fold ---
    pred_prob <- predict(model, X_test, type = "prob")[, 2]
    roc_obj <- roc(Y_test, pred_prob)
    auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
    outer_auc[i] <- auc_val
    
    # --- Store individual ROC data for later plotting ---
    roc_df <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      one_minus_spec = 1 - roc_obj$specificities
    )
    all_preds[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      true_label = Y_test,
      pred_prob = pred_prob
    )
  
    # --- Extract coefficients (non-zero only) ---
    best_lambda <- model$bestTune$lambda
    final_fit <- glmnet(X_train, Y_train, alpha = alpha, family = "binomial", lambda = best_lambda)
    coefs <- as.matrix(coef(final_fit))
    nonzero <- rownames(coefs)[coefs != 0]
    nonzero <- nonzero[nonzero != "(Intercept)"]
    
    # --- Save feature list ---
    feature_list[[i]] <- data.frame(feature = nonzero, coef = as.numeric(coefs[nonzero, ]))
    
    # --- Store importance ---
    imp <- varImp(model)$importance
    matched_imp <- imp[match(colnames(X), rownames(imp)), 1]
    importance_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_imp), 0, matched_imp)
  }
  
  # --- Feature stability ---
  feature_stability <- bind_rows(feature_list) %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarise(
      selection_freq = n() / length(outer_cv),
      mean_coef = mean(coef)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_freq))
  
  # --- Combine importance ---
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    feature = colnames(X),
    mean_importance = colMeans(importance_matrix),
    importance_sd = apply(importance_matrix, 2, sd)
  )
  
  feature_stability <- merge(feature_stability, importance_df, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # --- Combine all predictions ---
  all_preds_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)
  
  # --- Return results ---
  list(
    auc = mean(outer_auc),
    auc_sd = sd(outer_auc),
    outer_auc = outer_auc,
    feature_stability = feature_stability,
    all_preds = all_preds_df
  )
}



plot_rocs <- function(lasso_res) {
  roc_data <- lasso_res$all_preds

  # Initialize ggplot
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add reference line
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black")

  # Plot individual outer fold ROC curves
  for (i in unique(roc_data$fold)) {
    fold_data <- roc_data[roc_data$fold == i, ]
    fold_roc <- roc(fold_data$true_label, fold_data$pred_prob)

    fold_df <- data.frame(
      x = 1 - rev(fold_roc$specificities),  # ascending 1 - specificity
      y = rev(fold_roc$sensitivities)       # ascending sensitivity
    )

    p <- p + geom_step(
      data = fold_df,
      aes(x = x, y = y),
      color = "pink",
      alpha = 0.8,
      linewidth = 0.7
    )
  }

  # Plot overall ROC (all outer folds combined)
  overall_roc <- roc(roc_data$true_label, roc_data$pred_prob)
  overall_df <- data.frame(
    x = 1 - rev(overall_roc$specificities),
    y = rev(overall_roc$sensitivities)
  )

  set.seed(12345)
  ci_auc <- ci.auc(overall_roc, method = "bootstrap")

  p <- p + geom_step(
    data = overall_df,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
    labs(
      title = "Nested CV ROC Curve",
      subtitle = sprintf("AUC = %.3f (95%% CI: %.3f–%.3f)",
                         auc(overall_roc), ci_auc[1], ci_auc[3]),
      x = "1 - Specificity",
      y = "Sensitivity"
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_minimal()

  return(p)
}

```

```{r}
library(Boruta)
run_rf_boruta_nestedcv<- function(X, Y, outer_folds = 5, inner_folds = 3) {
  
  set.seed(12345)
  # Create outer folds
  outer_cv <- createFolds(Y, k = outer_folds, list = TRUE, returnTrain = TRUE)
  
  
  outer_auc <- numeric(length(outer_cv))
  all_preds <- list()
  feature_list <- list()

  importance_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  mda_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  gini_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = length(outer_cv), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(importance_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  colnames(mda_matrix) <- colnames(X)
  colnames(gini_matrix) <- colnames(X)

  
  for (i in seq_along(outer_cv)) {
  cat("Outer fold", i, "of", outer_folds, "\n")
  
  train_idx <- outer_cv[[i]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_along(Y), train_idx)
  
  X_train <- as.matrix(X[train_idx, ])
  Y_train <- Y[train_idx]
  X_test  <- as.matrix(X[test_idx, ])
  Y_test  <- Y[test_idx]
  
    # 3-fold CV with 5 repeats with Boruta feature selection (ONLY on training data)
    set.seed(i) # For reproducibility
    boruta <- Boruta(X_train, as.factor(Y_train), maxRuns = 50) 
    selected_features <- getSelectedAttributes(boruta, withTentative = TRUE)
    
    X_train_boruta <- X_train[, selected_features, drop = FALSE]
    X_test_boruta  <- X_test[, selected_features, drop = FALSE]
    
    # 3. Train RF on Boruta-selected features
    ctrl <- trainControl(
      method = "none",  # no resampling; rely on OOB
       classProbs = TRUE,
      summaryFunction = twoClassSummary
      )
    
    p <- length(selected_features)


    model <- train(
      x = X_train_boruta,
      y = make.names(Y_train), # caret requires valid factor names
      method = "rf",
      trControl = ctrl,
      tuneGrid = data.frame(mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(X)))),
      metric = "ROC",
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    
    # --- Predict on outer test fold ---
    pred_prob <- predict(model, X_test_boruta, type = "prob")[, 2]
    roc_obj <- roc(Y_test, pred_prob)
    auc_val <- auc(roc_obj)
    outer_auc[i] <- auc_val
    
    # --- Store individual ROC data for later plotting ---
    roc_df <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      sensitivity = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      one_minus_spec = 1 - roc_obj$specificities
    )
    
    # --- Save predictions ---
    all_preds[[i]] <- data.frame(
      fold = i,
      true_label = Y_test,
      pred_prob = pred_prob
    )
  

    # --- Save feature list ---
    feature_list[[i]] <- data.frame(feature = selected_features)
    

    # SAFELY store variable importance
    imp <- varImp(model)$importance
    
    mda  <- importance(model$finalModel)[,"MeanDecreaseAccuracy"]
    gini <- importance(model$finalModel)[,"MeanDecreaseGini"]
    
    matched_imp <- imp[match(colnames(X), rownames(imp)), 1]
    matched_mda <-  mda[match(colnames(X), names(mda))]
    matched_gini <- gini[match(colnames(X), names(gini))]
    
    importance_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_imp), 0, matched_imp)
    mda_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_mda), 0, matched_mda)
    gini_matrix[i, ] <- ifelse(is.na(matched_gini), 0, matched_gini)
    
  }

  
  # --- Feature stability ---
  feature_stability <- bind_rows(feature_list) %>%
    group_by(feature) %>%
    summarise(selection_freq = n() / length(outer_cv)) %>%
    arrange(desc(selection_freq))
  
  # --- Combine importance ---
  importance_df <- data.frame(
    feature = colnames(X),
    mean_importance = colMeans(importance_matrix),
    importance_sd = apply(importance_matrix, 2, sd),
    Mean_MDA = colMeans(mda_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_MDA = apply(mda_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Gini = colMeans(gini_matrix, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Gini = apply(gini_matrix, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  feature_stability <- merge(feature_stability, importance_df, by = "feature", all.x = TRUE)
  
  # --- Combine all predictions ---
  all_preds_df <- bind_rows(all_preds)
  
  # --- Return results ---
  list(
    auc = mean(outer_auc),
    auc_sd = sd(outer_auc),
    outer_auc = outer_auc,
    feature_stability = feature_stability,
    all_preds = all_preds_df
  )
}


```

```{r}

# Run Random Forest (should now work without errors)

rf_results_B_CD_M <- run_rf_boruta_nestedcv(t(vst_forest_B_CD_M_top) , Y, outer_folds = 5, inner_folds =3)

top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig = subset(rf_results_B_CD_M$feature_stability, selection_freq > 0)

top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig = annotate_ML(top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig,ensembl)


top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig <- top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig[
  order(top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig$mean_importance, decreasing = TRUE), ]

write.csv(top_rf_features_B_CD_M_sig,file="~/ML/rf_features_B_CD_M_sig_M.csv")
```
